name: prompt-910
image_purpose: social-media collage and influencer lifestyle moodboard

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 2x2 grid collage featuring one consistent approved adult subject.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark brown or black hair, loose waves in three panels and sleek high ponytail in one, glamorous natural makeup and trendy luxury styling.
prompt.composition_elements: Four distinct panels: outdoor night cake moment with black halter top and gold jewelry; daytime city car-door look with white sleeveless top and denim; indoor brown matching set mirror selfie with gold-frame mirror and handbag; golden-hour vehicle or street close-up with mauve tank, beige sherpa jacket and layered gold jewelry.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Panel-specific night foliage, bright city sunlight, warm indoor hallway and golden-hour lighting; coherent premium influencer collage.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 2x2 grid, consistent identity and realistic smartphone photography, sharp texture, no borders unless source layout requires them.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 2x2 lifestyle collage of one approved adult woman with dark brown or black hair, loose waves in three panels and sleek high ponytail in one: outdoor night foliage panel holding a round white cake with red cherries and gold jewelry; daytime upscale city panel leaning from a black luxury car in a white sleeveless top and blue jeans; indoor beige hallway panel in a chocolate two-piece set with gold-frame mirror and patterned handbag; golden-hour vehicle or street panel in a light mauve ribbed tank and beige sherpa jacket with layered gold jewelry, natural expressions, realistic smartphone photography, no invented text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, child, minor, licking or sexual gesture, inconsistent face, distorted anatomy, bad hands, plastic skin, watermark, text, logo
